title: Microsoft (MSFT) Beats Q3 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
text: Microsoft (MSFT) came out with quarterly earnings of $4.27 per share, beating the Zacks Consensus Estimate of $4.07 per share. This compares to earnings of $3.46 per share a year ago.

title: MAG 7 EARNINGS: GOOGL, MSFT, AMZN, META
text: Marley Kayden, Sam Vadas, and Alex Coffey take investors through a busy post market earnings lineup with live reaction to Amazon (AMZN), Microsoft (MSFT), Meta Platforms (META), and Alphabet (GOOGL) reporting. ======== Schwab Network ======== Empowering every investor and trader, every market day.

title: Microsoft Q3 results top expectations, driven by Intelligent Cloud strength
text: Microsoft Corp (NASDAQ:MSFT) reported fiscal third quarter earnings that exceeded Wall Street expectations, driven by continued strength in its cloud and artificial intelligence businesses. The company posted revenue of $82.9 billion for the quarter ended March 31, up 18% year over year.

title: Microsoft Q3 Highlights: AI Revenue Up 123% YoY, Hits Annual Run Rate $37 Billion, Helps With Double Beat
text: Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ:MSFT) announced third-quarter financial results on Wednesday after market close.

title: MSFT More than 20% Below Record High: Can AI Growth Offer Rebound?
text: Microsoft (MSFT) needs to show its AI CapEx spending is paying off, says John Belton. His focus will be on Microsoft Azure cloud growth and ways Copilot plays a role in it.

title: KG: MSFT Earnings Important After Pullback, Don't Expect Interest Rate Movement
text: Kevin Green talks about where markets are positioned and the risks of Mag 7 companies doubling down on AI CapEx spending. He notes to keep an eye out for Microsoft (MSFT) as it and other Big Tech names have pulled back aggressively over the last quarter.

title: Microsoft Heads Into 'Biggest Earnings Day Ever' Near The Bottom Of The Mag 7
text: Microsoft Corp. (NASDAQ:MSFT) headlines what one analyst is calling “the biggest earnings day ever,” with four members of the Magnificent 7 reporting after Wednesday's closing bell.
